issues.on_page: Miscellaneous income/(expense) (74,097) (General (253,985), Special Revenue 179,888); budget schedules pp7-8 call the same amounts 'Other state receipts'

issues.on_page: Personal and real property taxes 355,928 = p4 General column Property taxes 331,065 + Homestead exemption 24,863

issues.on_page: Other local receipts: budget 174,000, actual 262,485 (split into sales tax 178,253 + interest 7,911 + charges 76,321)
